client_isolation.notes: Especially relevant for routers provided by Movistar and O2

notes: If CG-NAT is active, a public IP must be requested from the ISP
DIGI offers this via an additional service package
This is a common cause of pairing and remote connectivity issues

pairing_best_practices: Temporarily disable router firewall if pairing fails
Avoid dual-band WiFi with same SSID (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz)
Use a dedicated SSID for 2.4 GHz
If multicast pairing fails, use point-to-point (AP mode)

notes: Check maximum number of connected devices supported by ISP router
ISP routers usually have limited capacity
solutions: Connect it via Ethernet to the ISP router

cg_nat.definition: CG-NAT (Carrier-Grade NAT) allows multiple users to share a single public IP address, limiting network functionality for IoT systems.
impact: Issues with third-party integrations (e.g., VPN, local servers)

procedure: Request public IP or opt-out of CG-NAT
notes: May be free or have additional cost
DIGI offers it as an add-on service

technical_recommendation: Verify if connection uses CG-NAT before installation
cg_nat.support_note: If remote access fails, verify CG-NAT as a possible cause
